title: Document
description: A record held by or for the strata corporation, such as minutes, bylaws, financial statements, contracts or reports.
x-validationRules: uri must not be publicly accessible when accessLevel is anything other than public.
supersedesDocumentId must not reference this document.
x-legalReviewNotes: Records retention and owner access rights are defined by legislation; accessLevel is a hint for systems, not a legal classification.

id.description: Stable identifier of this Document record.

strataCorporationId.description: The strata corporation this record belongs to.

x-enumDescriptions.plan: Strata plan or other registered plan.

documentDate.description: Date of the document (for example, the meeting date for minutes).

version.description: Version label assigned by the publisher.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the file (for example application/pdf).

uri.description: Location from which an authorized recipient can retrieve the file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file, hex encoded.

accessLevel.description: Intended audience. Describes intent; it does not grant access.

x-enumDescriptions.restricted: Restricted (for example, legal or personal information).

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
